authority: T0 exact finite-regulator classical and quantum circuit route split; not a TECT claim, tier change, two-null Goursat reconstruction, physical state or energy selection, CP1 completion, or Pre-A closure
statement: For every fixed even periodic CL8 regulator, the exact Strang split of the inherited kinetic and interacting position potential defines a reversible radius-one classical symplectic circuit and a finite-depth unitary circuit on the same canonical variables and hbar. Its B(H) Heisenberg automorphism has an exact discrete causal cone and transports every declared density state exactly. In the quadratic tangent sector the circuit is metaplectic and preserves the finite Weyl algebra with an exact Floquet symbol. Four broader routes fail: the quartic kick does not normalize the nonlinear Weyl C-star algebra, the split circuit does not conserve the inherited autonomous CL8 energy or automatically preserve its ground or Gibbs states, the bounded principal Floquet logarithm has no trace-class Gibbs exponential on the infinite-dimensional Hilbert space, and the radius-one update has a rank-deficient sideways neighbour block and therefore does not itself give full two-null characteristic reconstruction.
verdict: ADVANCE AN EXACT CAUSAL CAUCHY FLOQUET CIRCUIT AND B(H) STATE TRANSPORT; RETAIN THE COMMON CHARACTERISTIC MODEL, FULL NONLINEAR WEYL, STATIONARY PHYSICAL STATE, AND ENERGY-REFERENCE GATES

finite_regulator.domain: Lambda_M=Z/(MZ) with even M>=4, L>0, a=L/M, and eight real Q3 species at every node
finite_regulator.field_variables: q_(j,e)=psi_(j,e), Pi_(j,e)=chi*dot psi_(j,e), and canonical p_(j,e)=w*Pi_(j,e)
finite_regulator.symplectic_form: Omega_a=sum_(j,e) dp_(j,e) wedge dq_(j,e)=w*sum_(j,e) dPi_(j,e) wedge dq_(j,e)
finite_regulator.autonomous_comparator: H_a=T_a+U_a, exactly the inherited fixed-regulator CL8 Hamiltonian in canonical p coordinates
finite_regulator.parameter_domain: chi>0, c>0, g>0, lambda>=0, r real, hbar>0, and nonzero step delta

classical_circuit.one_period: F_delta=D_(delta/2) composed with K_delta composed with D_(delta/2)
classical_circuit.symplectic_result: both shears and their composition preserve the full canonical Omega_a exactly because Hess U_a is symmetric
classical_circuit.reversibility: F_(-delta)=F_delta^(-1), and momentum reversal R(q,p)=(q,-p) obeys R F_delta R=F_delta^(-1)
classical_circuit.locality: grad U_a at node j uses only j-1,j,j+1; therefore one period has graph radius one and every derivative of F_delta^n from an input outside the periodic n-neighbourhood is exactly zero
classical_circuit.scope: an exact discrete-time Cauchy circuit for a periodically driven split model, not the exact continuous-time flow of H_a and not yet a two-null Goursat map

quantum_circuit.operators: Q and P are the canonical Schrodinger operators with [Q_(j,e),P_(k,f)]=i*hbar*delta_jk*delta_ef
quantum_circuit.algebra: B(H_a), kept distinct from the universal finite Weyl C-star algebra and its concrete Schrodinger image
quantum_circuit.automorphism: alpha_delta(A)=Uhat_delta^* A Uhat_delta is a normal unital star automorphism of B(H_a)
quantum_circuit.generator_action: on the common Schwartz core, alpha_delta sends the Q,P generators by the same D-K-D formulas as F_delta
quantum_circuit.exact_cone: Dhat is onsite and Khat factorizes into commuting onsite and nearest-neighbour position-phase gates; alpha_delta^n maps a bounded local algebra on X into the bounded local algebra on the exact periodic n-neighbourhood of X
quantum_circuit.normality_boundary: the exact full interacting statement is on B(H_a); Weyl generator closure is asserted only for the quadratic sector

quadratic_tangent_symbol.ordered_collective_mass: m_ordered^2=-2r/chi=9 in the inherited PA-H1 calibration
quadratic_tangent_symbol.exact_results: det S_delta(k)=1; the elliptic stability window is 0<x_k<4; cos theta_k=1-x_k/2 and omega_F(k)=theta_k/delta=(2/delta)*asin(delta*omega_a(k)/2)
quadratic_tangent_symbol.Weyl_status: with W(z)=exp(i*sigma(z,Z)/hbar) and alpha_delta(Z)=S_delta(k) Z, the full quadratic finite-regulator S_delta(k) is linear symplectic, has a metaplectic implementer, and alpha_delta(W(z))=W(S_delta(k)^(-1) z)
quadratic_tangent_symbol.causal_speed_boundary: a/delta is a regulator input; the exact Floquet frequency is not the continuous CL8 frequency and no emergent light speed is derived

state_transport.input_states: any registered trace-one positive density rho on H_a, including the inherited interacting ground projector or finite-beta Gibbs density of H_a
state_transport.Heisenberg_identity: Tr(rho_n*A)=Tr(rho*alpha_delta^n(A)) for every A in B(H_a)
state_transport.result: positivity, trace one, normality, and regularity after restriction to Weyl generators are exact at every finite n
state_transport.selection_boundary: transport is not stationarity, a ground rule, a beta derivation, or physical-state selection; the full finite Hilbert space is transported, so there is no hidden symplectic complement in this Cauchy-to-Cauchy statement

nonlinear_Weyl_nonnormalizer.attempt: promote the exact nonlinear B(H_a) circuit to an automorphism of the concrete unital Weyl C-star algebra A_W=C*(1,W(z))
nonlinear_Weyl_nonnormalizer.witness: for a nonzero one-coordinate configuration translation T_y, Khat_delta*T_y*Khat_delta^*=M_f*T_y with f(x)=exp[-i*delta*(U(x)-U(x-y))/hbar]
nonlinear_Weyl_nonnormalizer.quartic_effect: g>0 makes the phase difference a polynomial with a nonzero cubic leading term; exp(i*P_3(x)) is not uniformly continuous because increments pi/P_3'(x) tend to zero while the phase increment tends to pi
nonlinear_Weyl_nonnormalizer.algebra_boundary: a contractive modulation-average proof gives A_W intersect the multiplication operators = AP(R^(8M)): nonzero translation coefficients average to zero and fixed multiplication operators are norm limits of the surviving trigonometric multipliers; every AP function is uniformly continuous, so M_f*T_y is not in A_W
nonlinear_Weyl_nonnormalizer.conclusion: the quartic kick and therefore the full nonlinear split circuit do not normalize A_W; the exact automorphism survives on B(H_a) or a separately justified enlarged algebra
nonlinear_Weyl_nonnormalizer.survivors: the quadratic metaplectic sector, resolvent or crossed-product enlargements, and other explicitly defined observable algebras

autonomous_energy_and_state_no_go.attempt: reuse exact finite-depth causality while claiming exact conservation of the inherited autonomous H_a and automatic stationarity of its ground and Gibbs states
autonomous_energy_and_state_no_go.actual_ordered_CL8_witness: around the ordered collective equilibrium v0=sqrt(-r/g), the exact analytic energy defect has positive quadratic coefficient mu*omega^6*delta^4/8 with omega^2=-2r/chi; therefore the inherited nonlinear H_a is not identically conserved by F_delta
autonomous_energy_and_state_no_go.quantum_boundary: even the quadratic metaplectic control does not commute with its H_0, so its harmonic ground and finite-beta Gibbs density are squeezed rather than stationary
autonomous_energy_and_state_no_go.conclusion: the registered interacting densities may be transported, but their stationarity under Uhat_delta and a common conserved physical-energy ledger do not follow
autonomous_energy_and_state_no_go.survivors: a separately proved invariant Floquet state, a different energy-preserving exact-causal model, a time-dependent work ledger, or an enlarged clock system

principal_Floquet_Gibbs_no_go.attempt: define a preferred thermal state and absolute energy reference from the bounded principal logarithm of Uhat_delta alone
principal_Floquet_Gibbs_no_go.bounded_log: the principal Floquet Hamiltonian has spectrum in a bounded interval of width 2*pi*hbar/|delta|
principal_Floquet_Gibbs_no_go.trace_obstruction: on infinite-dimensional H_a, exp(-beta*H_F,principal) is bounded below by a positive multiple of the identity and has infinite trace for every beta>0
principal_Floquet_Gibbs_no_go.branch_boundary: other logarithms are nonunique and may shift different spectral sectors by integer multiples of 2*pi*hbar/delta; Floquet data alone therefore supplies no unique ground or additive physical reference
principal_Floquet_Gibbs_no_go.conclusion: the principal-log Gibbs route fails; no physical empty-space state or below-empty-space sign is obtained
principal_Floquet_Gibbs_no_go.survivors: an independently selected invariant density, an unbounded logarithm with proved locality and trace class, a finite-dimensional onsite truncation with a separate CCR boundary, or an external physical reference principle

sideways_characteristic_no_go.attempt: infer a full two-null-side characteristic reconstruction directly from the radius-one Cauchy circuit
sideways_characteristic_no_go.neighbour_block: for each species, the derivative from the neighbour pair (q_(j+1),p_(j+1)) to the output pair (q'_j,p'_j) is an outer product proportional to [(delta/(2mu)),1]^T*[1,delta/(2mu)] and has rank one rather than two
sideways_characteristic_no_go.eight_species_rank: the complete neighbour block has rank at most eight instead of the sixteen needed for a local full canonical sideways inverse
sideways_characteristic_no_go.conclusion: the current split circuit is not locally sideways-invertible on the full canonical phase space; exact finite propagation is not a two-sheet Goursat theorem
sideways_characteristic_no_go.survivors: an enlarged chiral or dual-unitary circuit, a multi-cell constrained boundary quotient with a proved symplectic radical, or a separately constructed discrete Goursat scheme

prior_art_boundary: Symplectic splitting, variational and Floquet integrators, finite-depth local quantum circuits, metaplectic covariance, almost-periodic Weyl algebras, and the distinction between causal circuits and dual-unitary or sideways-invertible circuits are established mathematics. No world-first or new general theorem is claimed. The repository-specific result is the exact CL8 one-eighth canonical normalization, Q3 potential, B(H)/Weyl algebra firewall, ordered-mode Floquet symbol, actual registered-density transport, and four-way gate split under one finite-regulator ledger.
no_overclaim: This package constructs a discrete-time exact-causal Cauchy circuit on each fixed CL8 regulator and an exact B(H) state-transport automorphism. It does not construct a two-null boundary or discrete Goursat reconstruction, preserve the nonlinear Weyl C-star algebra, conserve the inherited autonomous CL8 Hamiltonian, prove the inherited interacting ground or Gibbs state stationary, derive a unique Floquet energy or physical reference, identify physical empty space or a below-empty-space sign, produce inter-regulator compatible states, a continuum or Hadamard state, derive hbar, Lorentzian nullness, cooling, a phase transition, full 3+1 dynamics, gravity, an event horizon or a cycle, close C0 or N1-N5, advance C6, complete CP1, or complete Pre-A.
